name: Canh chua ca khoai
summary: Canh chua cá khoai is a sour soup Dân Việt calls a Cần Giờ specialty, even while it says cá khoai lives mainly in central Vietnam. The fish is round and long, with soft translucent flesh and very fine bones. The soup uses pineapple, tamarind, tomato, bean sprouts, ngổ, and spring onion.
origin: Can Gio. Dân Việt, 28 Apr 2024. The fish is described as mainly central, and the soup as a local plate.
howToEat: Eat it as a soup. The story says the fish was not popular in Cần Giờ until this sour soup.
